summary: RAG sequential in-context + LoRA adapter v2a_e1
hypothesis: Combining the ragSequential in-context topology (exp016) with the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 should yield additive gains — the retrieval-augmented prompt structure and the fine-tuned weights each independently help, so together they should outperform either alone.
technique: A matrix-sweep cross of the ragSequential in-context inference topology (raw exp016) with the best LoRA adapter (v2a_e1): RAG exemplars are retrieved and injected into context, then the adapter-fine-tuned model generates questions — testing whether the two orthogonal improvements compound.
result: Scored 0.248 on the full-30 greedy eval — barely above the raw exp016 baseline (0.245) and far below the champion exp056 (0.440). The in-context RAG topology provided no meaningful lift when crossed onto the LoRA adapter, falsifying the compounding-gains hypothesis; discarded.
label: exp072
